first.rationale: I currently intend to simplify onboarding because completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence indicates onboarding changes can improve time-to-value and early adoption. I will verify the onboarding result and the competing promotional-pricing result before committing, since aggressive competitor pricing may warrant a targeted response but could optimize acquisition without sustainable qualified revenue. A small guarded test should track qualified activation, time-to-value, retention signals, and revenue quality rather than completion alone.

final.rationale: Run a standard controlled onboarding-simplification experiment this week. The verified result directly addresses the 4% completion decline and supports improved time-to-value, activation, and 30-day retention. Measure qualified activation, time-to-value, qualified revenue, and retention—not completion alone. Do not use promotional pricing: although it lifted short-term qualified revenue, the 12% retention decline indicates poor sustainable revenue quality.
